description: Current data-freshness status of the weather platform: overall state, per-source states (ok / degraded / outage / no_signal), open incidents with cause attribution (provider outage vs internal processing delay), and active provider advisories. Use this when a user asks whether data is current, when other tools return surprisingly stale data, or before presenting time-critical weather. If a source is degraded or in outage, tell the user their data may be stale rather than presenting it as live. No inputs. Refreshed about every 5 minutes.

include_ok.description: true: list every monitored source including healthy ones. false (default): only sources that are not ok, keeping the response compact.

name: get_platform_status

generated_at.description: When the status document was generated (UTC).

overall.description: Worst state across customer-facing data sources; "unknown" when status is unavailable.

warming.description: true when no_signal only means monitoring is still warming up (not an outage).

title: Get platform status
